converters.title: Synchronous buck
converters.summary: 24 V → 9 V at 200 kHz, with digital voltage-mode control: an ADC sample and a controller update every PWM period, run by firmware written in C.

converters.title: Synchronous boost
converters.summary: 12 V → 48 V at 100 kHz, with the same digital voltage-mode firmware: the right-half-plane zero of the boost keeps the crossover near 1.5 kHz.

converters.title: Four-switch buck-boost
converters.summary: 8–16 V → 12 V at 100 kHz: two legs and one inductor, so the input can sit above or below the output. Buck-boost mode, all four switches switching, with the same firmware.
